question: How much hypothetical Lane-1 wait reduction is required before WITHDRAW_AND_PRIORITY_REATTEMPT can exceed RETAIN_AND_REATTEMPT on benchmark-success probability?

paired_random_numbers.reason: Retain and withdraw share the same base wait, run-duration, and future-speed draws so that only the assumed priority benefit changes.

break_even_definition: First TESTED priority-reduction level where P(withdraw final result >= decision-time benchmark) > P(retain final result >= decision-time benchmark).
allowed_claims: Under stated structural wait-reduction scenarios, priority may or may not offset withdrawal downside.
Benchmark-success crossover can be reported as a sensitivity threshold on the tested grid.
Zero-priority scenario is the equal-wait baseline.
forbidden_claims: Lane 1 historically reduces wait by 25/50/75 percent
the crossover identifies the true optimal action
historical causal effect of lane choice
